dialect.detail: GnuCOBOL with extended screen section features (BACKGROUND-COLOR, FOREGROUND-COLOR, REVERSE-VIDEO, CRT STATUS, FUNCTION ALL INTRINSIC, REPOSITORY clause). Portuguese-language comments suggest Brazilian origin. Likely compiled with GnuCOBOL 2.x or 3.x.
evidence: OCCURS ... DEPENDING ON with INDEXED BY

purpose.domain_detail: Sandwich shop ingredient management system called BREADWICH/DELICIOUSSANDWICH
purpose.summary: This program is the 'View Ingredients' module of a sandwich shop ingredient management system (BREADWICH). It reads an indexed file of ingredients, loads them into a table, presents a menu to the user, and allows viewing individual ingredient records or a list of ingredients via a screen-based interactive interface.

notable_features: SCREEN SECTION with rich TUI layout (BACKGROUND-COLOR, FOREGROUND-COLOR, REVERSE-VIDEO)
CRT STATUS for keyboard function key detection (KEYSTATUS)
FUNCTION ALL INTRINSIC via REPOSITORY clause
Indexed file (ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED, ACCESS MODE IS DYNAMIC)
COPY statements for FD and WS definitions (FD-INGREDSFX, WS-INGREDSFX, CONSTANTS-INGREDS)
88-level condition names used for EOF and validation
verdict.notes: Source truncated at 16000 chars; PROCEDURE DIVISION is partially visible. The program appears to be a lab exercise (comment: 'LAB | SECOND PART') for a Brazilian student project. No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS. No COMP-3 usage. Program type classified as batch since there is no CICS, though it is interactive terminal-based.
